positive_activation: A task may use independent repository workers, translation shards, or coordinated final verification.
A request asks to decide whether parallel work is justified or how it should be bounded.
negative_activation: A known small one-file change with no useful parallel work.
A task that lacks current user authorization for subagent delegation.
neighboring_skill_discrimination: Load the domain, localization, testing, Bootstrap, or security skill alongside this orchestration policy; this skill does not replace their task-specific contracts.
workflow_application: Apply the hard gate and score before dispatching a worker, then give a bounded context packet and declared scope.
Freeze English, fingerprint it, and delegate translation work to workers with disjoint locale files before using the five-worker exception.
Keep final integration, environment isolation, paired full-suite scheduling, and combined result review in the main coordinator.
failure_or_edge_case: Treat a changed English fingerprint, shared locale file, unavailable worker model, or scope expansion as a reason to keep work in the parent or stop the worker.
If test environment and default application environment isolation is not proven, do not run the two isolated full-suite workers concurrently.
Preserve and group all paired complete-suite failures, repair them with targeted tests, and rerun the pair only after the known failure set is resolved.
reference_validation: Confirm expected_references exactly matches the directly linked topical Markdown references and no forbidden reference is loaded.
